items.name: scene-spec
items.title: Scene spec
items.description: Compiles a YAML-shaped scene spec into a Remotion scene for either orientation, with timed blocks, explicit layouts, orientation overrides, and configurable safe areas.
items.snippet:
import { SceneFromSpec } from "@/jbm/motion/compile"
import type { ScenesFile } from "@/jbm/motion/spec"

const scenes: ScenesFile = parsedYaml
<SceneFromSpec spec={scenes.scenes[0]} orientation="landscape"
  host={{ resolve: (phrase) => timings[phrase] }} />
// Every block and field: https://github.com/chekos/jbm-ui/blob/main/docs/scene-spec.md

items.name: folder-carry
items.title: Folder carry
items.description: Folder carried along a path by its tab, interpolating size and label between two resting places.
items.snippet:
import { FolderCarry, folderGrip, tableFolderGeometry } from "@/jbm/ui/folder-carry"

const from = tableFolderGeometry({ x: 5, y: 65 }, 100)
const to = tableFolderGeometry({ x: 225, y: 60 }, 190)
const path = [folderGrip(from), { x: 200, y: 45 }, folderGrip(to)]

<svg viewBox="0 0 450 270" width="100%">
  <FolderCarry from={from} to={to} path={path} progress={0.5} label="proyecto" />
</svg>
